name: hermes
title: Hermes
description: Talk to the Hermes Agent, follow your tasks and pick up in Hermes Desktop — without leaving Raycast.
author: savio22

commands.name: ask-hermes
commands.title: Ask Hermes
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: Ask Hermes a question and get the answer on the spot, with the option to keep the conversation going.

arguments.name: pergunta
arguments.placeholder: What do you want to ask?

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: Hermes Conversations
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: See, search, continue, rename and organize your Hermes conversations, including the ones from Hermes Desktop.

commands.name: run-task
commands.title: Run a Task in Hermes
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: Ask Hermes for a longer task and follow every step through to the final result.

commands.name: active-runs
commands.title: Hermes Tasks
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: Follow tasks in progress, answer approval requests and reopen recent results.

commands.name: models
commands.title: Hermes Models
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: See the models available in your Hermes and pick which one to use by default. Shortcuts can be set in the Raycast settings.

commands.name: check-connection
commands.title: Check Hermes Connection
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: Check whether Hermes is running and whether the connection from the extension works.

commands.name: configure-hermes
commands.title: Configure Hermes
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: Connect the extension to the Hermes installed on this computer, with no terminal required.

commands.name: ask-selection
commands.title: Ask About Selection
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: Ask Hermes about the text you selected or copied, without leaving what you were doing.

arguments.name: pergunta
arguments.placeholder: What do you want to know?

commands.name: summarize-clipboard
commands.title: Summarize Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: Summarize the text you just copied, as bullet points.

commands.name: fix-clipboard
commands.title: Fix Clipboard Text
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: Fix spelling, grammar and punctuation in the copied text, with no commentary.

commands.name: translate-clipboard
commands.title: Translate Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: Translate the copied text between English and Portuguese, or into the language you name.

commands.name: paste-answer
commands.title: Paste Latest Answer
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: Paste the most recent Hermes answer into the app you are in.

commands.name: skills
commands.title: Hermes Skills
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: See which skills are enabled in your Hermes and what each one does.

commands.name: toolsets
commands.title: Hermes Tools
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: See the tool groups in your Hermes and which ones are ready to use.

commands.name: jobs
commands.title: Hermes Automations
commands.subtitle: Hermes
commands.description: Follow your Hermes automations; pause, resume or run one right now.

preferences.name: apiServerKey
preferences.title: Hermes Key
preferences.description: Local key of the Hermes API Server (API_SERVER_KEY). It lives in the .env file of your Hermes installation. It is never sent outside your computer.

preferences.name: apiUrl
preferences.title: Hermes Address
preferences.description: Leave this blank to detect it automatically. Fill it in only if your Hermes uses another port.

preferences.name: sessionKey
preferences.title: Memory Scope
preferences.description: Stable identifier Hermes uses to keep the long-term memory of this origin separate. Left blank, the extension uses the default for your system: raycast:windows:default on Windows and raycast:macos:default on macOS.

preferences.name: defaultProvider
preferences.title: Default Provider
preferences.description: Optional. Provider used when you do not pick another one at the time.

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: Optional. Model used when you do not pick another one at the time.

preferences.name: streamResponses
preferences.title: Answers
preferences.label: Show the answer while Hermes writes
preferences.description: Turn this off if you prefer to get the answer only once it is complete.

preferences.name: maxHistoryItems
preferences.title: Items per Page
preferences.description: How many conversations to load at once in the lists.
